g1.flow: Word for word the same in both, and each comes straight after an oath. In Al-Ḥāqqah it follows 'and what you do not see' and is followed by 'not the word of a poet'. In At-Takwīr it follows the dawn that breathes and is followed by the messenger's power with the Owner of the Throne. Hook: Ḥāqqah denies the poet, Takwīr describes the messenger.

cues.69:40: After 'and what you do not see'; next, 'not the word of a poet'.
cues.81:19: After the dawn when it breathes; next, possessed of power with the Owner of the Throne.

g2.flow: One core line, huwa illā dhikrun lil-ʿālamīn, with two openings. Ṣād and At-Takwīr start with in; Al-Qalam alone starts wa mā, answering 'Indeed, he is mad' and closing its surah. Ṣād's follows 'I do not ask you any payment'; At-Takwīr's follows 'So where are you going?'. Hook in muṣḥaf order: in, wa mā, in.

cues.38:87: In huwa illā: after 'I ask no payment' and 'I am not of the pretentious'.
cues.68:52: Wa mā huwa illā: answers 'Indeed, he is mad'; last ayah of Al-Qalam.
cues.81:27: In huwa illā: after 'So where are you going?'; next, whoever wills a right course.
